context.region: Northern Uganda (specific community to be selected)
resources: food available at home or in the community; confirm availability, affordability and water locally
culturalNotes: DRAFT: candidate examples only. Do not claim these foods are available in every community. Confirm food names, language and preparation with someone who knows the selected community.

General Uganda nutrition profile (FAO, 2010) describes regional variation and lists millet, sorghum, cassava, beans and leafy greens among foods found in some northern/eastern contexts: https://www.fao.org/4/aq011e/aq011e.pdf. This broad, older source does not validate present-day availability or customs in a specific Northern Uganda community.

review.notes: Revisión pedagógica aprobada por Carlos Herrero el 4 nov 2026. La validación cultural local sigue pendiente: confirmar alimentos, preparación, nombre Ayo y adecuación del inglés con una persona de la comunidad concreta. No probado con niños. Esta aprobación no implica validación por la comunidad. Segunda revisión de las actividades de seguridad «ask-how-to-prepare» y «help-with-cooking» por Sergio Chillón el 2026-11-05: leídas, sin objeciones; no sustituye la validación cultural local.

activities.prompt: Ayo helps prepare a meal with their family. Today they use food they have at home. Another family may choose different foods.
activities.audioText: Ayo helps prepare a meal with their family. Today they use food they have at home. Another family may choose different foods.
activities.feedback: Families make choices based on what they have and what they usually eat.

activities.prompt: Ayo's family has millet and beans. Which answer names both foods in the story?
activities.feedback: Yes, the story says the family has millet and beans. Families in different places may have different foods.

activities.prompt: Put these steps in order for washing your hands before eating, if water and soap are available.

options.text: Dry with a clean cloth if one is available

activities.feedback: Washing hands before eating is a hygiene habit. If water or soap is not available, ask an adult to help find a safe option.

activities.prompt: You do not know if a food needs cooking. What can you do?
activities.feedback: It is okay to ask for help. Ask a trusted adult to help you find out whether the food needs cooking and how to prepare it safely.

activities.prompt: Preparing the meal needs a knife or a fire. What can you do?

options.text: Ask an adult to help you

activities.feedback: Good choice. Ask an adult to stay with you when knives or fire are needed.
